note: USACE Louisville District campground on a wooded peninsula in Nolin River Lake near Cub Run; many sites along the shoreline. The lake is drawn down in winter, leaving a wide sand-and-mud margin. Run by volunteer hosts with no staffed gate; swimming beach, boat ramp, fishing pier, playground and picnic shelters. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees $18-32 confirmed. 68 reservable sites (52 W/E to 50A, 16 non-electric), no sewer, max 105 ft; season 05-07..10-16 (new); reservations required. Lakefront confirmed: B18, B20, B22, A13, A11, A09, C10/C11 within ~10-25 m of the summer-pool line on open, thinly treed ground, all sold by the night. PIN MOVE ~260 m: stored pin is in forest east of the loops -> 37.3219,-86.1318. Dump not confirmed (left as stored).
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED (stored lakefront): on Esri imagery (a winter-drawdown frame) the peninsula's perimeter sites sit beside the vegetation line that marks summer pool, on open ground with scattered and dead trees, and the drawdown margin below them slopes gently: B18 (37.323146,-86.132220) ~15-20 m, B20 (37.323117,-86.132688) ~20-25 m, B22 (37.322927,-86.132936) ~15-20 m, A13 (37.322856,-86.131154) ~20 m, A11 (37.322655,-86.130845) ~20 m, A09 (37.322374,-86.130778) ~25 m, C11 (37.321801,-86.133477) ~10 m and C10 (37.321874,-86.133284) ~15 m. All are reservable by the night. Distances are to the summer-pool vegetation line (the drawdown memory rule), not to the winter water. rec.gov: 'Campsites are located along the shoreline, allowing easy access to the lake and beaches'.

PIN MOVE: stored 37.3208333,-86.1291667 (rec.gov's facility point) is in unbroken forest ~180 m east of site A01 and ~260 m from the middle of the loops. Suggest location -> 37.3219,-86.1318 (between loops A and B).

ELECTRIC '100': 30 sites carry 'Electricity Hookup: 100' in the catalog (likely a data-entry slip); taken as 50A, the highest the other sites list. Four sites (B001-B003, C004) are '20/30/50' with Max Vehicle Length 20 - too short for a 23-ft rig.
